protocol.render: Same 1280x720 offscreen Metal renderer, target 60 Hz, 1450 shader iterations. GPU device utilization sampled every 500 ms. Frame-service p95 is for the simulated renderer.
protocol.steady_six_frames: Two continuous gameplay recordings. Four six-second windows per recording, no repeated six-frame input within an order. Sample from the 0.5 s capture cadence and evenly select six according to the production window selection. Use the unchanged product thumbnail, Frame labels and contact sheet, byte-identical between versions.
protocol.worker: Warm independent workers, one active request at a time. Alternate version order and reverse it in a second run of the long requests. Wall clock covers reading/writing the fixed JPEG, worker IPC, first attempt, format recovery and the final full response. Original 160-token review cap, same greedy settings.
protocol.quality: Complete means parseable allowed scene, nonempty observation and distinct visible frame labels 1–6; strict_boxagent_observation uses the unchanged production HighlightReview parser. These are distinct measures. Time to TTS and game FPS are outside the recorded worker latency.
protocol.native: Opt-in production GameCompanion, recorded windows and mock audio transport. The live capture loop decides which six frames to select; per-case frame hashes indicate any mismatch.
protocol.p95: nearest rank; validation rows repeat eight distinct windows across two execution orders.
